suggestions.placement: Homepage hero section / 'How it works' section
suggestions.rationale: While Cal.com has feature-specific videos, a concise homepage explainer would quickly articulate the core value proposition and the simple 'how it works' process to diverse audiences (individuals, businesses, developers), improving immediate understanding and engagement before they delve into specific features.
suggestions.observed_site_quote: How it works: 01 Connect your calendar, 02 Set your availability, 03 Choose how to meet

suggestions.placement: Pricing page, above the plan comparison table
suggestions.rationale: The pricing page is text-heavy, detailing numerous features across four distinct plans. A video could visually walk prospects through the key differentiators and benefits of each paid tier (Teams, Organizations, Enterprise), helping them quickly grasp the value proposition and choose the best plan without extensive reading.
suggestions.observed_site_quote: Choose your Cal.com subscription Start scheduling for free, with no usage limits. For collaborative features, choose one of our premium plans that fits your company size.

suggestions.placement: Homepage 'Testimonials' section or a dedicated 'Customer Stories' page
suggestions.rationale: Cal.com features compelling text testimonials from respected industry leaders. Converting these into video testimonials would significantly enhance social proof, build trust, and allow potential customers to hear authentic experiences directly, making the benefits more tangible and relatable.
suggestions.observed_site_quote: Don’t just take our word for it Our users are our best ambassadors. Discover why we're the top choice for scheduling meetings. 'More elegant than Calendly, more open than SavvyCal, Cal.com works and it feels just right.' Flo Merian Product Marketing, Mintlify
